name: html_named_entity
description: Encode reserved HTML characters and non-breaking space as named entities; matched control copies a supplied label.
generator_code:
import random,json,html
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
chars=['&','<','>','"','\u00a0']
for i in range(100):
 c=chars[i%5];label=random.choice(['alpha','beta','gamma','delta','epsilon','omega']);name='non-breaking space' if c=='\u00a0' else repr(c)
 ans='&'+html.entities.codepoint2name[ord(c)]+';'
 p=f'HTML encoding record {label}: character {name}. '
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only its standard named HTML entity. Entity:', 'answer':' '+ans})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Copy the record label. Label:', 'answer':' '+label})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
